sloka: आसीत् तव कृते कर्म त्रिलोक विदितम् नृप ।कामम् अस्ति महत् सैन्यम् तिष्टतु इह परंतप ॥३-३८-१०॥
transliteration: āsīt tava kṛte karma triloka viditam nṛpa ।kāmam asti mahat sainyam tiṣṭatu iha paraṁtapa ॥3-38-10॥

translations.english: 'O scourge of foes as you wish, let your great army wait here. Even though Rama is young he is glorious, and capable of subduing the enemy. I will take him. Be blessed.'
